name: Lethbridge Favourites 2026

venue.name: Excite Lethbridge
venue.address: 101 Exhibition Wy S, Lethbridge, AB T1J 4R3

information: ### Outside Food not permitted### This venue does **not** allow anyone to bring outside food or drinks in. Bringing in water is allowed. The venue's concession will be open. We apologize for the inconvenience and we thank you for your cooperation. **Registration Reminders** You must register and pay the registration fee before your registration can be accepted. **Unpaid registrations will not be accepted**. ​ Since this is a "favourites" competition, you may choose **at most five (5) events**. ​ Please review all of the tabs listed on this website. Attendance is not required for the entire competition. However, **please arrive at least 15 minutes before the events that you compete in or help in are planned to start**. Please bring your own puzzles for the events you are competing in. ​ Once your registration has been accepted, you will no longer be able to change your events by yourself. If you would like to change them, send the organization team an email and we will change your events for you as long as you inform us before September 11, 2026 at 6:00 PM MST. ​ **First-Time Competitors: All newcomers must be familiar with the WCA Regulations before competing.** There is a video [here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww&t=2s&ab_channel=cyotheking) for a basic overview of the rules. ​ **Notice of Filming and Photography** Attendees of competitions consent to their images being used by SpeedCubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.
